facts.P1_fx_receipts: Probably yes; exporters must receive by bank within 180 days and sell some currency.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks like BCEL offer USD and THB accounts; cash dollars can be scarce.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register an individual enterprise with the Ministry of Industry and Commerce.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN on your enterprise certificate, or from the tax office via taxservice.mof.gov.la.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed; services pay 3% of turnover at LAK 50–400 million.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 10% VAT, and services to foreign clients are not zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Electronic Data Protection Law: consent needed to send data abroad.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.

watch_out.text: Services for foreign clients still pay 10% VAT, despite some guides' claims.
Using foreign software for customer data needs consent to transfer it abroad.
